brief:
Middle East Eye published an opinion piece examining how a pragmatic coalition could transform Middle Eastern geopolitics nearly three years after the October 7 Hamas attack. The piece argues that the 2023 attack disrupted what had been a status quo arrangement serving US-Israeli interests while marginalizing Palestinian rights.

The commentary suggests that the current moment offers an opportunity to reconfigure regional relationships around practical interests rather than existing power structures. The analysis appears timed to a midpoint assessment of how the conflict and its aftermath have altered diplomatic and strategic calculations across the region.

title: Analyst envisions pragmatic regional axis reshaping Middle East politics
